safety_line: Switch off and lock out (LOTO) the machine before opening any guard.

cnc: Check spindle bearings for wear and noise
Check lubrication and the auto-lube pump
Call the machine maker's service engineer
press: Check hydraulic oil level and temperature
Look for leaks at seals and hoses
Check pump and relief valve pressure
boiler: Check water level in the gauge glass

records.symptom: Compressor tripped on high temperature (110°C) in the afternoon, whole plant air down
records.cause: Oil cooler fins choked with dust
records.action: Cleaned cooler fins with compressed air and water

records.symptom: Spindle vibrating heavily above 3500 rpm, alarm 2041 (spindle vibration high), surface finish rough
records.action: Replaced front spindle bearing (7014 angular contact)
records.notes: Vibration reduced but came back after about 7 weeks

records.symptom: Boiler tripped on low water level but gauge glass shows normal level
records.action: Replaced level switch
records.notes: Tripped again after 4 days.

records.symptom: ATC arm stuck midway during tool change, alarm 1012 tool change timeout
records.cause: Swarf (chips) on ATC proximity sensor, sensor gap wrong
records.action: Cleaned swarf off ATC proximity sensor, set sensor gap to 1.5 mm

records.symptom: Low-water trip again, gauge glass normal
records.cause: Scale on the level probe; softener salt tank empty so hard water reaching boiler
records.action: Descaled level probe, did blowdown, refilled softener salt and regenerated softener
records.notes: Check softener salt every Monday.

records.symptom: High temperature trip again
records.cause: Cooling fan motor capacitor weak, fan slow
records.action: Replaced fan motor capacitor

records.symptom: Press ram moving slow, oil temperature 68°C
records.action: Replaced main cylinder seals
records.notes: Still slow after seal change.

records.symptom: Ram still slow after seal change, oil hot
records.cause: Pump suction strainer clogged, oil degraded
records.action: Cleaned pump suction strainer, changed hydraulic oil (VG 68)
records.notes: Slow + hot = strainer first. Seals only if oil leaks outside.

records.symptom: Pallet changer not clamping, alarm 3105 pallet clamp pressure low
records.cause: Rotary joint o-ring leaking, clamp pressure dropping below 40 bar
records.action: Replaced rotary joint o-ring, set clamp pressure to 45 bar, cleaned pressure switch
records.notes: Keep spare o-rings.

records.symptom: High temperature trip, oil looks dark
records.cause: Oil level low and oil separator element choked
records.action: Topped up oil, replaced separator element
records.notes: Blow the cooler fins every Friday in summer.

records.symptom: Alarm 401 servo overload on X-axis, axis moving rough
records.cause: Way-lube oil tank empty, auto-lube pump fuse blown
records.action: Replaced lube pump fuse, refilled way-lube tank

records.symptom: Alarm 2051 spindle orientation fault during tool change
records.action: Re-seated and clamped spindle encoder cable

records.symptom: Alarm 1012 again, ATC slow and stopping
records.cause: Air pressure at ATC regulator only 5.2 bar (needs 6 bar) plus chips on sensor
records.action: Set ATC air regulator to 6 bar, cleaned proximity sensor
records.notes: Low air pressure makes the ATC slow and time out.

records.symptom: Low-water trip, gauge glass normal
records.cause: Scale on level probe, softener salt empty again
records.action: Descaled probe, refilled salt
records.notes: Salt again empty.

records.symptom: Alarm 2041 again, vibration above 3500 rpm, slight whistling sound at high speed
records.action: Replaced front spindle bearing again
records.notes: Vibration back within 19 days. Bearing was not the problem.

records.symptom: Spindle not starting, main breaker trips at spindle start
records.cause: Supply voltage dipping during spindle start
records.action: Corrected servo stabilizer settings, checked drive DC bus

records.symptom: Emergency stop not resetting, press dead
records.action: Replaced safety relay

records.symptom: Alarm 2041, whistling sound above 4000 rpm, vibration felt at motor end
records.cause: Motor-to-spindle coupling misaligned by 0.08 mm and coupling spider (rubber element) worn
records.action: Checked alignment with dial gauge, realigned motor to spindle to under 0.02 mm, replaced coupling spider, torqued coupling bolts to 45 Nm
records.notes: Whistling sound above 4000 rpm was the clue. No vibration for 80+ days.

records.symptom: No coolant flow, coolant pump motor smelling burnt
records.action: Replaced coolant pump motor

records.symptom: Alarm 401 again on X-axis
records.cause: Way-lube tank empty again — nobody refilling
records.action: Refilled way-lube tank
records.notes: Add lube level to shift start checklist.

records.symptom: Low-water trip on morning start
records.cause: Scale on level probe, salt empty
records.action: Descaled probe, blowdown, refilled salt
records.notes: Same root cause — salt refill is being missed.

records.symptom: Hissing sound, pressure dropping, auto drain stuck open
records.action: Cleaned auto drain valve

records.symptom: Alarm 3105, pallet not clamping
records.action: Replaced pallet clamp pressure switch
records.notes: Alarm came back after 30 minutes.

records.symptom: Alarm 3105 continuing after pressure switch change
records.action: Replaced rotary joint o-ring, reset clamp pressure to 45 bar
records.notes: Same as June. The new pressure switch was not needed.

records.symptom: Ram slow, oil warm
records.action: Tightened hydraulic fittings
records.notes: No change.

records.symptom: Ram still slow
records.cause: Suction strainer clogged again — dirt entering through torn rod wiper seal
records.action: Cleaned suction strainer, replaced rod wiper seal

records.symptom: First time on CNC-2: ATC stuck, alarm 1012
records.cause: Chips on proximity sensor and air at 5.4 bar
records.action: Used twin machine CNC-1 history from Ustaad: cleaned sensor, gap 1.5 mm, air regulator to 6 bar
records.notes: Twin-machine learning: fixed on first try.

records.symptom: Alarm 2051 again
records.action: Re-seated encoder connector and added a strain-relief clamp

records.symptom: Low-water trip, gauge glass normal
records.action: Ustaad: descaled probe + refilled softener salt (did not change level switch)

records.symptom: Through-spindle coolant pressure low, tool overheating
records.cause: Coolant filter clogged with fine chips
records.action: Cleaned coolant filter and flushed the line

records.symptom: Pressure stuck at 5.5 bar, not loading
records.action: Replaced inlet valve solenoid coil

records.symptom: Oil leaking from pressure hose near cylinder
records.action: Replaced pressure hose

records.symptom: Mild alarm 2041 at 4200 rpm, small whistling sound
records.action: Followed Ramesh-ji's July fix from Ustaad: dial gauge check, realigned to 0.015 mm, bolts to 45 Nm
records.notes: Did NOT touch the bearing. Fixed in 75 minutes using Ustaad.

records.symptom: Burner lockout, flame failure alarm
records.action: Cleaned flame photocell

records.symptom: Alarm 401 on CNC-1 X-axis
records.action: Checked lube tank first (Ustaad, from twin CNC-2), refilled

records.symptom: Coolant pump making grinding noise, low flow
records.action: Cleaned pump impeller and suction strainer

records.symptom: Low-water trip again
records.cause: Scale on level probe, salt empty
records.action: Descaled probe, refilled salt
records.notes: Pattern: every ~40 days.

records.symptom: Alarm 3105 on night shift, pallet not clamping
records.action: Ustaad pointed to the o-ring first (not the switch). Replaced o-ring, pressure 45 bar
records.notes: Fixed in 50 minutes on night shift without calling Ramesh-ji.

records.symptom: Night shift high temperature trip
records.action: Cleaned cooler fins (Ustaad: same as May)

records.symptom: Night shift: ram slow, oil 62°C
records.action: Ustaad said strainer first: cleaned suction strainer
records.notes: Did not touch seals.

records.symptom: Vibration rising with a whistling sound above 4000 rpm, spindle nose warm but below 70 °C
records.action: Checked coupling alignment with a dial gauge; realigned to under 0.02 mm; ran up to 6000 rpm and re-checked vibration
records.notes: Bearings were NOT changed — saved about ₹38,000.

records.symptom: Ram slow on return stroke, oil at 62 °C after one hour
records.cause: Pump suction strainer choked with sludge
records.action: Cleaned the suction strainer; topped up oil to the mark; checked return-line filter

records.symptom: Alarm on tool change: spindle does not stop at the orientation position
records.cause: Chips and coolant film on the orientation proximity sensor
records.action: Cleaned the proximity sensor face; set the sensor gap to 1 mm; tested 20 tool changes

records.symptom: Vibration 5.2 mm/s at 4500 rpm after a heavy roughing job
records.action: Followed Sunil's fix from Ustaad: dial-gauge alignment check; torqued coupling bolts; re-checked under 0.02 mm

records.symptom: ATC arm stops halfway, alarm 1012
records.cause: Air pressure at the ATC regulator only 4.8 bar
records.action: Set the ATC regulator to 6 bar; drained water from the FRL unit

tips.text: If CNC-3 shows alarm 2041 with a whistling sound above 4000 rpm, it is the motor-spindle coupling, not the bearing. Check alignment with a dial gauge first — it must be under 0.02 mm. Spindle bearings cost ₹38,000; replace them only if the spindle nose temperature crosses 70°C.
Alarm 3105 pallet clamp: 9 out of 10 times it is the small o-ring in the rotary joint (₹350), not the pressure switch. Keep 5 spare o-rings in the maintenance cupboard.
Boiler low-water trip while the gauge glass looks normal means scale on the level probe. The real cause is the softener salt running out. Refill salt every Monday and the trips stop.
Press slow and oil hot: clean the pump suction strainer first. Change seals only if oil is leaking outside the cylinder. Check the rod wiper seal — a torn wiper lets dirt in and chokes the strainer.
From April to June the compressor overheats in the afternoons. Blow the cooler fins every Friday in summer and check the oil level weekly.
ATC alarm 1012 on the VMC-850 machines (CNC-1 and CNC-2): check air pressure at the ATC regulator is 6 bar and clean swarf off the proximity sensor. Sensor gap should be 1.5 mm.
Alarm 401 servo overload on a VMC-850 is almost always an empty way-lube tank. Check the tank at every shift start.
Before calling the machine company's service engineer for any CNC, check the coupling, lubrication and air pressure first — it saves the ₹15,000 visit charge most of the time.

Don't wait for the machine to trip on vibration. On our CNC spindles, above 4.5 mm/s I plan a stop for the same day; above 7.1 mm/s I stop the machine at once — that is the 'damage' zone for a machine this size.
In 10,000 public machining runs, tool-wear failures started at about 200 minutes of tool life. We change cutting tools at 180 minutes on the VMC-850 instead of waiting for a broken tool.

Heat failures in the public machining data happened only when the process ran less than 8.6 K hotter than the air AND the spindle was below 1380 rpm. So at low speed in the afternoon heat, check coolant flow before blaming the spindle.
Servo overload 401 on CNC-2 came back twice in the same week — check the way-lube pump timer too, not only the tank.

public.title: Tool wear failure — 46 cases in 10,000 machining runs
public.text: Rule seen in the data: Tool wear reaches about 200-240 minutes.

public.title: Heat dissipation failure — 115 cases in 10,000 machining runs
public.text: Rule seen in the data: Process minus air temperature below 8.6 K AND spindle speed below 1380 rpm.

public.title: Power failure — 95 cases in 10,000 machining runs
public.text: Rule seen in the data: Power (torque × speed) below 3,500 W or above 9,000 W.

public.title: Overstrain failure — 98 cases in 10,000 machining runs
public.text: Rule seen in the data: Tool wear × torque above 11,000 (L), 12,000 (M) or 13,000 (H) min·Nm.

public.title: Random failure — 19 cases in 10,000 machining runs
public.text: Rule seen in the data: About 0.1% chance on any run — no warning sign.

public.title: ISO 10816-1 vibration zones for machines
public.text: For medium machines (15-75 kW): up to 1.12 mm/s good, 1.12-2.8 acceptable, 2.8-7.1 unsatisfactory (plan repair), above 7.1 mm/s damage likely. Small machines: limits 0.71 / 1.8 / 4.5 mm/s.
public.fix: Plan a stop in the 'unsatisfactory' zone; stop at once in the 'damage' zone.
